title: Kamailio v6.1.0 Released
html:
February 18, 2026: Kamailio v6.1.0 is out –  a new major release, bringing new features and improvements added during about one year of combined development and testing.

In short, this major release brings 4 new modules and a significant number of updates to most of the existing modules, plus components of the core as well as for embedded interpreters (KEMI framework). Detailed release notes are available at:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/w/kamailio-v6-1-0-release-notes/

Enjoy SIP routing in a secure, flexible and easier way with Kamailio v6.1.0!

Note also the dates of the next Kamailio World Conference: May 7-8, 2026 to take place again in Berlin, Germany:

  • https://www.kamailioworld.com

Thank you for flying Kamailio! Stay safe and healthy!
